F2-42.notes_for_reviewers: Load against penetration for a 4-inch cylinder in dense RS soil at four rates of penetration. Printed upright. Four lines: A (LPT 22) dotted, B (LPT 23) solid, C (LPT 24) long dashes with short gaps, D (LPT 25) shorter dashes. Near zero penetration all four rise in one bundle next to the left frame; tell them apart by line style, and answer cannot tell where you cannot. A crosshair inside the frame line, or in the white gap between dots or dashes, is a no.

F2-44.notes_for_reviewers: Load against penetration for a 4-inch cylinder in dense RS soil in three bin sizes. Printed upright. Five lines: LPT 74 is the only dotted line; LPT 69 and 64A are solid (69 stays above 64A); LPT 24 and 73 are dashed with the same dash pattern (LPT 73 is labeled along its line; the arrow of the LPT 24 label points to the other dashed line). Below about 200 lb all five lines run together into one band beside the left frame; a crosshair there can rarely be told to belong to one test, so answer cannot tell unless the line style shows it.
